sources.role: path roots (path_util/fs_paths), qt-config and [Controls], input profiles, savedata layout, key files, NAND registered contents; no save-state module
Citron Neo linux AppImage / windows zip / macOS dmg install entries
manual:nintendo-switch-keys / manual:nintendo-switch-firmware sources; eden/ryubing/torzu rules exist, no citron entries

paths.path: ~/.config/citron/qt-config.ini (ConfigDir = $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/citron, default ~/.config/citron; a portable user/ dir next to the binary takes priority) — controller mappings live in its [Controls] section; named input profiles are separate ini files at ~/.config/citron/input/<profile>.ini
evidence: source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp POSIX branch — portable user/ dir wins, else GetDataDirectory("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") / CITRON_DIR (fallback home/.config)

paths.path: ~/.local/share/citron/nand/user/save/ ($XDG_DATA_HOME/citron/nand/user/save) — account saves at account/<128-bit user UUID hex>/<title id upper 16 hex>/0/, device saves at device/<title id 16 hex>/0/; SD card game data sits separately in ~/.local/share/citron/sdmc
paths.naming: Per-game directories keyed by Switch title id inside the NAND user save space, e.g. user/save/account/<uuid>/<000000000000B000>/0/; the GUI also recognises the legacy user/save/0000000000000000 layout

paths.path: ~/.local/share/citron/keys/prod.keys plus optional title.keys (KeysDir = data root / "keys"); dev.keys and key_retail.bin accepted in the same directory
evidence: source:src/citron/main.cpp — "Verify that it contains prod.keys, title.keys and optionally, key_retail.bin"

paths.path: Switch firmware is NCA content installed into the NAND system partition: ~/.local/share/citron/nand/system/Contents/registered/ (user-partition mirror at nand/user/Contents/registered)

linux.notes: No save-state feature: fs_paths.h defines no states directory and src/core has no savestate module at commit 91bbce7231 (purpose 'states' therefore omitted). Citron is the yuzu-descendant codebase, so the yuzu conventions hold but with CITRON_DIR "citron" (not citron-emu). Lunchbox DB gap: firmware-rules.json binds manual:nintendo-switch-keys and manual:nintendo-switch-firmware to eden/ryubing/torzu rules but has no citron:* rules yet.

paths.path: ~/.config/citron/qt-config.ini with [Controls] mappings and ~/.config/citron/input/<profile>.ini profiles — macOS shares the POSIX branch, and unset XDG_* vars fall back to home/.config (no bundle-local data dir)
evidence: source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp — POSIX (#else) branch applies to __APPLE__; GetDataDirectory falls back to GetHomeDirectory() / ".config" when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset

paths.path: ~/.local/share/citron/nand/user/save/ (account/<uuid>/<title id>/0/, device/<title id>/0/); SD card data in ~/.local/share/citron/sdmc
paths.naming: Per-game directories keyed by Switch title id inside the NAND user save space
evidence: source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp — NANDDir = XDG_DATA_HOME (default home/.local/share) / CITRON_DIR / NAND_DIR
source:src/core/crypto/key_manager.cpp — prod.keys / title.keys loaded from the Citron keys dir

macos.notes: macOS builds ship as dmg assets on the citron-neo/emulator GitHub releases (Lunchbox install source, x86_64 + aarch64); paths are the plain XDG defaults because the code has no macOS-specific data root.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\citron\qt-config.ini ([Controls] section; FOLDERID_RoamingAppData\citron) unless a user\ portable dir exists next to citron.exe; input profiles at %APPDATA%\citron\input\<profile>.ini
evidence: source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp _WIN32 branch — GetExeDirectory()/user else GetAppDataRoamingDirectory()/CITRON_DIR; config/cache follow the same root

paths.path: %APPDATA%\citron\nand\user\save\ (account/<uuid>/<title id>/0/, device/<title id>/0/); SD card data in %APPDATA%\citron\sdmc
paths.naming: Per-game directories keyed by Switch title id inside the NAND user save space
evidence: source:src/common/fs/path_util.cpp _WIN32 branch — NANDDir under the citron root
